details:
Earth Beats – NASA Space & Satellite Sonification Studio

Earth Beats is an innovative web-based project that transforms Earth's environmental and satellite data into an immersive musical experience. The main objective of this project is to make complex Earth observation data easier to understand through sound, visualization, and interactive technology.

The website allows users to explore different environmental parameters, including sea surface temperature, ocean currents, wind patterns, vegetation, air pollution, rainfall, moisture, and nighttime lights. By selecting different satellite and environmental data views, users can experience how various aspects of our planet can be represented through sound.

One of the most unique features of Earth Beats is its Earth Symphony functionality. It converts environmental values and atmospheric conditions into different musical elements, such as deep bass sounds, thermal harmonics, airflow resonances, and rainfall-inspired chimes. This process, known as sonification, provides an alternative way of experiencing and interpreting scientific information.

The platform also includes an interactive satellite map and a 3D Earth globe, allowing users to explore different geographical regions. Users can select locations, compare environmental conditions across different dates, upload their own images, and adjust parameters such as temperature, wind speed, cloud density, and wind direction. Audio controls allow users to customize individual sound layers and experience the combined Earth Symphony.

The project incorporates data sources and visualization resources such as NASA Blue Marble, NOAA OISST, MODIS, VIIRS, and Google Satellite Hybrid imagery.

The primary goal of Earth Beats is to combine science, technology, music, and creativity to create a new way of understanding our planet. It aims to increase environmental awareness, encourage scientific curiosity, and demonstrate how satellite observations can be transformed into an engaging and interactive educational experience.
